name: Christmas Uncle - Bolverk
source:
Located in a snowy little village in the far north, a cold and harsh environment where everybody is waiting for the Christmas tree, a new trend from the eastern regions.

Will they have a hot drink near the Christmas Tree? And what role have you in all of this.

[From [url=https://lupinigit.itch.io/christmas-uncle-bolverk]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
位于遥远北方的一个白雪皑皑的小村庄，寒冷而恶劣的环境中，每个人都在等待圣诞树，这是来自东部地区的新趋势。

他们会在圣诞树附近喝杯热饮吗？你在这一切中扮演什么角色？

[来自[url=https://lupinigit.itch.io/christmas-uncle-bolverk]Itch.io[/url]]
